hypothesis: Full per-epoch training coverage may improve the four existing heads without changing architecture or loss.
initialization: V18 ce_supcon external-only adapter and LayerNorm; all new heads freshly initialized identically where shared
pooling: attention-masked mean of all response tokens plus EOS; no first-token removal
head: LayerNorm(2560) -> Linear(2560,1800) -> GELU; dense Linear(1800,18) or 18 separate Linear(100,1) heads
projection: Linear(1800,256) -> GELU -> Linear(256,128); L2 normalization in SupCon
sampling: V42 coverage-first crossed rectangles; every training row per epoch, 541 batches on each existing split; identical schedule across arms.
schedule: fold 1 then fold 2; all four arms each; no interim winner selection
evaluation: Final epoch direct head, raw balanced accuracy; no posthoc readout or balance tuning

gate.action: Require broader confirmation and incremental ensemble evaluation; not automatic submission

budget.launch_requires: Reconciled prior costs with reserve, live quote and sufficient balance, external deletion watchdog before provisioning; no paid machine created by preparation.

limitations: Existing host labels and splits have been inspected previously; screening evidence only.
Dense and block readouts differ by 30,600 parameters; common 4.6M-parameter nonlinear map is identical.
Blocks are separate, not nested Matryoshka prefixes.
External-only initialization already used SupCon, shared across all four arms.
V42 versus V40 changes coverage, ordering, and one extra microbatch per epoch together; it cannot isolate those effects.
